_note: 1.98.1 (owner-approved planning/DRAFT_kedalaman_fitur.md batch 2): Dove watch. Dove_attention is how close the Dovecote is to what {{user}} keeps from it: the true magic, a forbidden technique, a forbidden pact (Pacting), Koschei's Needle in the Bag (Soul magic, lore 490/491) and Hidden.Secrets (violations kept from the Doves, written by the narrator). The meter and the stage line need no toggle (hidden magic has none); the events (rumour, posting, interview, room search, a knower talking) are the Features row dove_watch. Stages as before (stageOf): Unnoticed < 20, Rumoured < 40, Watched < 60, Investigated < 80, Exposed. Every draw is seeded (roll100, rollInt, pickOf).

stages.Rumoured: The Dovecote has heard a whisper, nothing more: Doves look at {{user}} a moment longer in passing.
stages.Watched: A Dove is on {{user}}'s routine: a white cloak turns up where {{user}} usually goes, never close, never hidden. Using a secret in sight of one is how attention jumps.
stages.Investigated: The Dovecote has opened a file on {{user}}: they ask {{user}}'s friends questions, check where {{user}} was, and want {{user}} in for a talk.
stages.Exposed: The Dovecote has enough to act on {secret}: expect Doves with a summons, at the door or in class. Sir Krieg Valforth leads it.

rumour.needle: Someone brought something back from Hanakaze that the Doves would want to see.
rumour.pact: Someone in the {dorm} Dormitory talks to something nobody else can see.
rumour.magic: Someone in the {dorm} Dormitory casts something that isn't on any syllabus.
rumour.deed: Someone went where the Doves say nobody goes, and got away with it.

posting.line: A Dove is posted near {place} today; {{user}}'s day passes there.

interview.milena_line: Milena Sagona comes to find {{user}} for a quiet word, "only a talk, Signor/Signora".
interview._names: 2.0.0 (bug-hunt audit K2, from the engine): names: how <now> and the log name the interviewer (with) and the one who comes instead when the interview is missed (second, the milena fields); call: the appointment's Desc; second_talk: the log's name for that talk.
interview.call: Sir Krieg Valforth wants {{user}} at the Dovecote for a talk
interview.line: The Dovecote interview is now ({who}; Fortune {n}{mods} = {total}): play it to this result.

results.clean: {{user}} gives them nothing; the file goes quiet for now.
results.partial: they let {{user}} go, unconvinced; they will look again.
results.fail: {{user}} slips: a detail that does not fit, a pause too long. Nothing is confessed unless {{user}} chooses to.

search.tip_line: Milena Sagona, in passing and very quietly: the Doves mean to look through {{user}}'s room tomorrow night.

results.clean: The Doves searched {{user}}'s room last night and found nothing; a book sits a little off where it was.
results.partial: The Doves searched {{user}}'s room last night and found something odd, but not enough.
results.fail: The Doves searched {{user}}'s room last night and found {item}. They will come for it: play the seizure in the story, where {{user}} can answer it.

hearing.call: A summons to a hearing before Sir Krieg Valforth

leak.line: Someone who knows has talked to the Doves this week: {who} (narrator only; play it in character, out of {{user}}'s sight).

cast_line: {{user}} used {what} with people around ({who}). If anyone could have noticed, report the Dove_attention rise; if not, nothing.
